headline: West Chester win first match, end Shippensburg's unbeaten run
dek: West Chester had drawn twice and lost once without a win before they went to Shippensburg and came away with one, and Shippensburg had not lost until they arrived. Millersville and Shepherd both drew the same afternoon, so no side in the conference is still unbeaten.
displaced_by: West Chester's first win came at Shippensburg, the last unbeaten side; the standing dek's claim that Millersville and Shippensburg hold every point no longer holds.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Millersville have scored more than any other programme while conceding three goals in six matches, as few as any side has let in; the scoring and the meanest defence sit at the same end of the chart.

wire.line: Every programme has now lost at least once; West Chester's first win of the season came at the last unbeaten side, Shippensburg.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded fourteen goals, more than any other programme has let in, and have lost three of their four matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lock Haven have drawn three and lost two of their five matches without a win, and their nine goals have come from seven different players.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has three goals and four assists from seventeen shots for Seton Hill.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Houck has made twenty-six saves for Shepherd and conceded five goals across their matches.

last_match.line: West Chester's first clean sheet since the opening day, and the first time Shippensburg have failed to score.

next_match.line: Gannon have not lost since their opener at home to Lake Erie; Felician were beaten at Bloomsburg in August.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
